study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Liu et al., Progress in Neuropsychopharmacology & Biological Psychiatry, 2024
study_identification_part.si4_title: Individualized functional connectome abnormalities obtained using two normative model unveil neurophysiological subtypes of obsessive compulsive disorder

cm1_research_objectives.reason: Objectives are clearly stated: the study aims to identify OCD subtypes using individualized functional connectome abnormalities derived via a normative modeling framework. The purpose of applying normative modeling (to obtain individualized deviations) is explicitly described.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "our aim was to identify potential OCD subtypes based on individualized functional connectome abnormalities. Individualized functional connectome abnormalities were obtained using normative models of functional connectivity strength (FCS) and used as features to unveil OCD subtypes."

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: NEW model built on local HCs. Eligibility for HCs is described (community recruitment, right-handed Han Chinese, detailed exclusion criteria). Image quality and data completeness standards are specified (motion thresholds of 3 mm/3°, FD computed; none excluded by this standard). Final sample sizes are reported (HCs N=104).
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "Healthy controls (HCs, n = 104) were enlisted from the community via poster advertisements. All participants were of Han Chinese ethnicity, right-handed, and underwent screening... exclusion criteria included..."; "Subjects were excluded if their translational or rotational displacement exceeded 3.0 mm or 3.0°... None of subjects was excluded according to this standard."; "Demographic and clinical characteristics... OCD (N = 99) | HCs (N = 104)"

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: The normative model includes age and sex as covariates when estimating the normative range in HCs. Multi-site effects are not applicable (single-site data).
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: "for each brain region, a Gaussian process regression model was trained to estimate the normative range of FCS values as a function of age and sex within HCs."

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: NEW model with primary data; the collection site is specified (First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University). The time period of data collection is not reported.
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "... recruited from outpatient services within the Department of Psychiatry at the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University."; "b Department of Magnetic Resonance Imaging, the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou, China"

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: PRIMARY data collection; modality and acquisition parameters are detailed (resting-state fMRI; TR, TE, slices, FOV, voxel size, duration). Equipment manufacturer/field strength are not reported.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: "A total of 242 contiguous wholebrain resting-state functional images were acquired over an 8-min period using GRE-EPI sequences... TR 2000 ms, TE 30 ms, flip angle 90°, FOV 220×220 mm, slice thickness 3 mm with 1 mm gap, voxel size 3.4×3.4×4 mm³."

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing software (DPABI) and detailed steps are provided (removal of first 10 volumes, slice timing, realignment, normalization, resampling, smoothing, detrending, band-pass filtering; nuisance regression including Friston-24, WM, CSF; despiking via AFNI 3dDespike). QC thresholds and FD computation are described.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: "The functional images underwent preprocessing using DPABI... removal of the first 10 volumes, slice timing correction, and realignment... normalized to the standard EPI template... smoothed... detrended... band-pass filter (0.01–0.1 Hz)... Friston 24 motion parameters, white matter and cerebrospinal fluid signal were regressed... despiking... 3dDespike... The mean frame-wise displacement (FD) was also calculated."

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: Internal validation via 10-fold cross-validation within the HC reference cohort is described for the GPR normative model; performance is subsequently summarized in Results.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "we evaluated the performance of the Gaussian process regression model in predicting FCS values within HCs through 10-fold crossvalidation."; "The 10-fold cross-validation performed on HCs demonstrated a high level of generalizability..."

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: No independent external healthy dataset is used to validate the normative model. Limitations explicitly note the need for validation on an independent dataset.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "Validation of our results should be pursued using an independent dataset to confirm the robustness of our findings."

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The statistical approach is described: Gaussian process regression trained per region using age and sex, producing Z-score deviations; 10-fold CV noted. Key implementation details such as kernel choice and software/libraries are not reported.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: "for each brain region, a Gaussian process regression model was trained to estimate the normative range of FCS values as a function of age and sex within HCs... A Z-score was calculated..."

nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.reason: Model fit is quantified using standardized MSE under 10-fold CV in HCs, reported as close to 1, with figures summarizing spatial distribution.
nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "The 10-fold cross-validation performed on HCs demonstrated a high level of generalizability... as evidenced by a mean MSE close to 1... The spatial distribution of MSE is depicted in Fig. S1."

nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.reason: While 10-fold CV is used, the sample sizes and demographics for each partition (training/validation/test) are not described.
nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.supporting_text: No partition-level sample size or demographic details reported.

nm11_reproducibility.reason: For NEW models, criteria include software/library versions and availability of code, trained models, and data. The manuscript does not specify software/library versions for normative modeling nor provide code/model/data availability statements.
nm11_reproducibility.supporting_text: No statement of normative model software versions or code/model/data availability found in the manuscript.
